why: Intro to the Terminal plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-terminal.json), 'Pipes and grep' (passes: rain.txt holds every line from the notes that mentions rain, in sorted order). The step says grep -hi; the learner left out -i, so day2.txt's 'Rain all morning' (capital R) was not matched. rain.txt exists and holds rain lines, but two of the three.

step.title: Save the sorted rain lines
step.instructions: Find every line that mentions rain in any note, whatever its case, sort the lines and save them: grep -hi rain notes/*.txt | sort > rain.txt. Then look at it with cat rain.txt.

targets.caption: Find, sort and save the rain lines

files.trail-log/notes/day1.txt:
Sunny start at the trailhead
Light rain after lunch
Camp by the creek
files.trail-log/notes/day2.txt:
Rain all morning
Trail muddy past the bridge
Skies cleared by four
files.trail-log/notes/summit.txt:
Windy at the top
No rain on the summit
Great view of the valley
files.trail-log/rain.txt:
Light rain after lunch
No rain on the summit

Terminal: tripi@mac trail-log % grep -h rain notes/*.txt | sort > rain.txt
